items.title: 14.4.11 Bhari dhatein (lead, mercury aur cadmium) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.4.11, printed page 310.

blocks.text: Lead, mercury aur cadmium jaisi heavy metals (bhari dhatein) waqai bare air pollutants ho sakti hain. Yeh factories ke processes, transport aur doosri insani activities se atmosphere mein aati hain. Metallurgy (dhaat nikalne aur saaf karne ka kaam), battery ka koora aur incineration (koore ko bhatti mein jalana) in ke bare sources hain.

blocks.prompt: Lead aur mercury hawa mein kahan se aate hain?
blocks.explanation: Lead pighlane ke kaam, lead-acid batteries ki recycling aur pehle leaded petrol se; mercury coal jalne, mercury wale koore ke incineration aur kuch dhaat aur chemical factories se.

items: Heavy metals Pb, Hg, Cd: metallurgy, battery ka koora, incineration, transport aur factories se.
